gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).
